name: STIHL MS 441 / MS 461
blurb: 18″ to 28″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ (33 RS3) or .063″ (36 RS3), from STIHL's 2017 selection chart. The 2025 chart does not repeat this model block.
intro: STIHL's 2017 saw-chain selection chart (specifications as of 1 October 2017) lists the MS 441 RC-M, MS 441 C-M, MS 441 C-MQ, MS 461 R and MS 461 in one block with the MS 362. The block has two gauges. At .050″ the loops are 33 RS3: 66 drive links on 18″, 72 on 20″, 84 on 25″ and 91 on 28″, plus asterisked 25″ and 28″ bars. At .063″ the loops are 36 RS3: 66 on 18″, 72 on 20″, 76 on 22″, 84 on 25″ and 91 on 28″. An asterisk, in STIHL's note, means a green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is not available at that length and a yellow-labeled bar is listed. The STIHL 2025 catalog chart names the MS 362 and MS 400 in this part of the table and does not name the MS 441 or MS 461. File size is where STIHL and Oregon disagree: STIHL's 2025 file table lists 13/64″ (5.2 mm) for 3/8″ chain, and Oregon's 2020 filing chart lists 7/32″ (5.5 mm) for standard 3/8″ chain.
notice: Two gauges are in the same chart block. .050″ chain is 33 RS3. .063″ chain is 36 RS3. The 2025 catalog chart does not list the MS 441 or MS 461. Read the stamp.

sources_note: STIHL USA “Saw Chain Selection and Identification” chart (catalog page 173, specifications as of 1 October 2017), read 9 Nov 2026. The 2025 Full Line catalog chart (catalog p. 166), read 9 Nov 2026, does not name the MS 441 or MS 461.
